push.account_moved.defaultMessage: {name} se ha mudado a otra cuenta
push.account_moved.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of an account that the user followed, which moved to another account.

push.admin_account_moved.defaultMessage: Una cuenta limitada por los moderadores de {instance} se ha mudado a otra cuenta
push.admin_account_moved.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: an account that the moderators limit moved to another account, which does not get the limit. It never names the accounts. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_appeal.defaultMessage: Hay una nueva apelación pendiente para los moderadores de {instance}
push.admin_appeal.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: a user appealed a moderation action. It never names the user. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_custom_emoji_request.defaultMessage: Hay una solicitud de emoji personalizado pendiente de revisión en {instance}
push.admin_custom_emoji_request.description: Web Push notification to an administrator: a user requested a custom emoji or a new image of one. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_report.defaultMessage: Hay una nueva denuncia pendiente para los moderadores de {instance}
push.admin_report.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: someone reported an account that had no open report. It never names the accounts. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_sign_up.defaultMessage: Hay un nuevo registro pendiente de aprobación en {instance}
push.admin_sign_up.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: a new user signed up and waits for approval. It never names the user. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_webhook_disabled.defaultMessage: Se ha desactivado un webhook de {instance}
push.admin_webhook_disabled.description: Web Push notification to an administrator: the server turned off a webhook endpoint that kept failing or answered that it is gone. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.announcement.description: Web Push notification of a new announcement of the server to every local user. {title} is the announcement's title, as the administrators wrote it. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.auto_delete_limit.defaultMessage: {instance}: las publicaciones con más de {days, plural, one {# día} other {# días}} se eliminarán automáticamente {daysLeft, plural, =0 {a partir de ahora} one {en # día} other {en # días}}
push.auto_delete_limit.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user that the server's maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts now applies to their posts. {days} is the most days after its publication that a post is kept; {daysLeft} is the days of the grace period until the maximum applies (0 when it applies at once). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.scheduled_status_failed.defaultMessage: {instance}: no se pudo publicar tu publicación programada {reason, select, restricted {porque tu cuenta no puede publicar ahora} reply_unavailable {porque la publicación a la que responde ya no está disponible} quote_unavailable {porque la publicación que cita ya no está disponible} media_unavailable {porque un archivo adjunto ya no está disponible} invalid {porque no cumple los requisitos de una publicación} rejected {porque la revisión automática del servidor la rechazó} other {}}
push.scheduled_status_failed.description: Web Push notification telling a local user that a post they scheduled could not be published at its time; the draft stays and can be fixed and scheduled again. {reason} says why: restricted (the account may not post now), reply_unavailable (the post it replies to is gone or does not take the reply), quote_unavailable (the post it quotes is gone or may not be quoted), media_unavailable (an attached file is gone or failed processing), invalid (the post does not pass the checks, such as its length), rejected (the server's automated review refused it). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.appeal_decided.defaultMessage: Los moderadores de {instance} han resuelto tu apelación
push.appeal_decided.description: Web Push notification: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.custom_emoji_request_decided.defaultMessage: Los administradores de {instance} han revisado tu solicitud de emoji personalizado
push.custom_emoji_request_decided.description: Web Push notification: an administrator approved or rejected the user's request for a custom emoji or a new image of one. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.boost.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that boosted the user's post.

push.favourite.defaultMessage: {name} ha marcado tu publicación como favorita
push.favourite.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that favourited the user's post.

push.filtered.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, about a post that one of the user's keyword filters with the action warn matched: it says what the notification is and names the filter instead of showing more. {title} is the usual text of the notification, such as “Alice mentioned you”; {filter} is the title of the filter, as the user wrote it.

push.follow.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that followed the user.

push.follow_accepted.defaultMessage: {name} ha aceptado tu solicitud de seguimiento
push.follow_accepted.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that accepted the user's follow request.

push.follow_request.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that asked to follow the user.

push.mention.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that wrote a post that mentions the user.

push.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: Los moderadores de {instance} te han enviado un aviso
push.moderation_notice.description: Web Push notification: a notice to the user from the moderators. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.other.description: Web Push notification of a kind without its own sentence. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.poll_closed.defaultMessage: Ha terminado una encuesta en la que participaste
push.poll_closed.description: Web Push notification: a poll that the user created or voted in has ended.

push.quote.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that quoted the user's post in a post of its own.

push.reaction.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that reacted to the user's post with an emoji.

push.relationships_severed.defaultMessage: Una suspensión de los moderadores de {instance} ha puesto fin a algunos de tus seguimientos
push.relationships_severed.description: Web Push notification: the moderators suspended a server or an account, which ended follows between it and the user. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.report_resolved.defaultMessage: Se ha resuelto una denuncia que presentaste en {instance}
push.report_resolved.description: Web Push notification: the moderators resolved a report that the user filed. It never says how. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.status.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of an account that the user subscribes to, which made a new post.

push.supporter_payment_failed.defaultMessage: Ha fallado un pago de tu plan de apoyo en {instance}
push.supporter_payment_failed.description: Web Push notification: a payment for the user's supporter plan failed. It never says where to pay (the app shows no way to pay). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.supporter_plan_retired.defaultMessage: Tu plan de apoyo en {instance} se ha retirado
push.supporter_plan_retired.description: Web Push notification: the administrators retired the user's supporter plan, whose subscription ends with its period. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.supporter_subscription_ended.defaultMessage: Tu plan de apoyo en {instance} ha terminado
push.supporter_subscription_ended.description: Web Push notification: the user's supporter subscription ended (a payment kept failing, a refund, a retired plan, or a cancellation). {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.service_closure_announced.defaultMessage: {instance} va a cerrar: exporta tus datos antes de que ocurra
push.service_closure_announced.description: Web Push notification to every user: the administrators announced that the server closes on a date. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.service_closure_rescheduled.defaultMessage: Ha cambiado la fecha de cierre de {instance}
push.service_closure_rescheduled.description: Web Push notification to every user: the administrators changed the dates of the announced closure of the server. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.service_closure_withdrawn.defaultMessage: {instance} no va a cerrar: se ha retirado el cierre
push.service_closure_withdrawn.description: Web Push notification to every user: the administrators withdrew the announced closure of the server, which goes on. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_service_closure_due.defaultMessage: Ha pasado la fecha de cierre de {instance}: cierra el servidor
push.admin_service_closure_due.description: Web Push notification to an administrator who may close the server: the closing date of the announced closure has passed, and the server closes only when an administrator closes it. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_error_group.created.defaultMessage: Se ha notificado un error nuevo en {instance}
push.admin_error_group.created.description: Web Push notification to an administrator who manages the errors: the server or the web client reported an error of a new kind. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_error_group.regressed.defaultMessage: Un error resuelto ha vuelto a ocurrir en {instance}
push.admin_error_group.regressed.description: Web Push notification to an administrator who manages the errors: an error that an administrator marked resolved happened again with a newer version of the server. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_error_group.others.defaultMessage: Se han notificado más errores en {instance}
push.admin_error_group.others.description: Web Push notification to an administrator who manages the errors: more new or recurring errors happened in this hour than are notified one by one, and they are counted in one notification. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_hook_failing.defaultMessage: Una revisión externa de {instance} sigue fallando
push.admin_hook_failing.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: calls of the external review of submissions keep failing. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_domain_list_failing.defaultMessage: Una suscripción a una lista de bloqueo de {instance} sigue fallando
push.admin_domain_list_failing.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: the fetches of a subscribed domain block list keep failing. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.admin_hook_appeal.defaultMessage: Se ha apelado ante los moderadores de {instance} una publicación rechazada
push.admin_hook_appeal.description: Web Push notification to a moderator: a user appealed a post that the server's automated review refused, and the appeal awaits review. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.hook_appeal_decided.defaultMessage: Los moderadores de {instance} han revisado tu apelación sobre una publicación rechazada
push.hook_appeal_decided.description: Web Push notification: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal of a post that the automated review refused. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.supporter_service_closure.defaultMessage: Tu suscripción de mecenas en {instance} termina con el cierre del servidor
push.supporter_service_closure.description: Web Push notification: the announced closure of the server cancels the user's supporter subscription at the end of its period. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name when it has none.

push.voice_room_started.defaultMessage: {name} ha iniciado una sala de chat de voz
push.voice_room_started.description: Web Push notification: an account that the user follows opened a voice chat room that the user may join. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the host.

push.voice_room_invited.defaultMessage: {name} te ha invitado a una sala de chat de voz
push.voice_room_invited.description: Web Push notification: the host or a co-host of a voice chat room invited the user to it. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that invited the user.

push.reply_request.defaultMessage: {name} ha pedido responder a tu publicación
push.reply_request.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose reply to the user's post waits for the user's approval.

push.boost_request.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose boost of the user's post waits for the user's approval.

push.quote_request.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account whose quote of the user's post waits for the user's approval.

push.interaction_accepted.defaultMessage: {name} ha aprobado tu interacción con su publicación
push.interaction_accepted.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the author of a post who approved the user's reply to it, boost of it, or quote of it.

push.interaction_rejected.defaultMessage: {name} ha rechazado tu interacción con su publicación
push.interaction_rejected.description: Web Push notification. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the author of a post who declined the user's reply to it, boost of it, or quote of it.

push.event_invited.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user that someone invited them to an event of the server. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of the account that invited them. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_schedule_confirmed.defaultMessage: Se ha fijado la fecha de {title}
push.event_schedule_confirmed.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user who answered the date poll of an event, or who was invited to it, that its organizers fixed the date. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_changed.defaultMessage: Ha cambiado la fecha o el lugar de {title}
push.event_changed.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user who is going, may go, or was invited that the organizers changed the date, the places, or the voice chat room of an event. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_cancelled.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user who is going, may go, or was invited that an event was cancelled. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_reminder.defaultMessage: {unit, select, day {{count, plural, one {{title} empieza en # día} other {{title} empieza en # días}}} hour {{count, plural, one {{title} empieza en # hora} other {{title} empieza en # horas}}} other {{count, plural, one {{title} empieza en # minuto} other {{title} empieza en # minutos}}}}
push.event_reminder.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, reminding a local user who is going or may go to an event that it starts soon, at the time before the start that the user chose. {unit} is day, hour, or minute, and {count} how many of them before the start. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_started.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling a local user who is going or may go to an event that it starts now. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_room_unavailable.defaultMessage: La sala de chat de voz de {title} no puede abrirse
push.event_room_unavailable.description: Web Push notification, and the subject of its email, telling the organizer of an event that its voice chat room cannot open, or could not, for example because the voice chat is off. The event itself stays. {title} is the title of the event, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of push.event_untitled when it has none.

push.event_untitled.description: Words for an event without a title (its organizer's account was erased), in place of {title} in the Web Push notifications of the events, such as “The date of an event is set”.
